description_en: Manages the endpoint and port of an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于管理实例的连接地址和端口
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-db-instance-connection-string --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --current-connection-string rm-uf6wjk5x0000.mysql.rds.aliyuncs.com --connection-string-prefix rm-0000 --port 3306 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBInstanceConnectionString

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The current endpoint of the instance. The endpoint can be an internal endpoint, a public endpoint, or a classic network connectivity endpoint in hybrid access mode.
The read-write splitting connection endpoint cannot be modified
parameters.help_zh:
实例当前的某个连接地址，可以是内外网连接地址，或者混访模式下的经典网络连接地址。
不支持修改读写分离连接地址
parameters.name: current_connection_string

parameters.help_en:
The prefix of the target endpoint. Only the prefix of the CurrentConnectionString parameter can be modified.
The prefix must be 8 to 64 characters in length and cannot contain Chinese characters or invalid characters (~!#%^&*=+\|{}'",<>/?). The prefix can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
目标连接地址的前缀，即只能修改CurrentConnectionString参数的前缀部分。
长度8~64，不能包含汉字和非法字符（~!#%^&*=+\|{};:'",<>/?），建议由字母、数字、短横线（-）组成
parameters.name: connection_string_prefix

parameters.help_en:
The TDS port number for Babelfish for RDS PostgreSQL.
This parameter is applicable only to ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances. For more information about Babelfish for RDS PostgreSQL, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428613.html
parameters.help_zh:
Babelfish for RDS PostgreSQL TDS端口号。
该参数仅适用于RDS PostgreSQL实例，Babelfish for RDS PostgreSQL的更多介绍，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428613.html
parameters.name: babelfish_port

parameters.help_en: The name of the group to which the dedicated cluster MySQL general-purpose instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 专属集群MySQL通用版实例所属的组名
parameters.name: general_group_name

parameters.help_en:
The PgBouncer port number.
This parameter is applicable only to ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances. If PgBouncer is enabled, you can modify the PgBouncer port number
parameters.help_zh:
PgBouncer端口号。
该参数仅适用于RDS PostgreSQL实例，如果开启了PgBouncer，则支持修改PgBouncer端口号
parameters.name: pg_bouncer_port

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the target ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with which you want to swap the endpoint.

This parameter is applicable only to ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances
parameters.help_zh:
需要交换连接地址的目标RDS PostgreSQL实例ID。

该参数仅支持RDS PostgreSQL实例
parameters.name: target_db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to retain the virtual IP address (VIP) when swapping the endpoint.

true: retains the VIP.
false (default): does not retain the VIP.

This parameter is applicable only to ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances
parameters.help_zh:
交换连接地址时是否保留虚拟IP地址（VIP）。

true：保留VIP。
false（默认值）：不保留VIP。

该参数仅支持RDS PostgreSQL实例
parameters.name: retain_vip
